theLabels: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival

country.match: Match each festival to its country.
country.odd: Three of these festivals are held in {value}. Which one isn't?

founded.sort: from the oldest to the newest
founded.shot: In what year was {label} first held? The festival {hook}.

rows.label: Ganesh Chaturthi
rows.description: multi-day Hindu festival revering god Ganesha (August–September)
rows.hook: honors the elephant-headed god with giant clay idols that are paraded and then immersed in water

rows.label: Burning Man
rows.description: annual experimental festival based in Nevada, United States
rows.hook: builds a temporary desert city each summer that ends with a giant wooden effigy going up in flames

rows.label: Raksha Bandhan
rows.description: annual ritual originating from the Indian Subcontinent
rows.hook: has sisters tie a decorative thread around their brothers' wrists as a sign of protection and love

rows.label: Oktoberfest
rows.description: world's largest beer festival in Munich, Bavaria, Germany
rows.hook: draws millions each autumn to drink beer from liter steins in big tents and wear lederhosen and dirndls

rows.label: Notting Hill Carnival
rows.description: annual street festival in London
rows.hook: fills west London's streets every August bank holiday with Caribbean costumes and sound systems

rows.label: Onam
rows.description: harvest festival of Kerala state, India
rows.hook: welcomes a legendary king with flower carpets, a huge banquet on banana leaves and snake boat races

rows.label: Venice Film Festival
rows.description: annual film festival held in Venice, Italy
rows.hook: awards the Golden Lion and is the oldest event of its kind in the world, held on a Lido island

rows.label: Reading and Leeds Festivals
rows.description: pair of annual music festivals in England
rows.hook: runs on twin sites over the August bank holiday weekend, with the same rock lineup playing at both

rows.label: Cannes Film Festival
rows.description: annual film festival held in Cannes, France
rows.hook: hands out the Palme d'Or each May on the French Riviera, with stars walking a famous red carpet

rows.label: Toronto International Film Festival
rows.description: annual film festival held in Toronto, Canada
rows.hook: is a major September stop for Oscar hopefuls, and its top prize is the People's Choice Award

rows.label: Sundance Film Festival
rows.description: annual film festival held in Utah, United States
rows.hook: is the top showcase for independent movies, held each winter in a snowy Rocky Mountain ski town

rows.label: Glastonbury Festival
rows.description: performing arts festival in Somerset, England
rows.hook: is a giant summer gathering on a dairy farm, known for its Pyramid Stage, mud and headline acts

rows.label: Lollapalooza
rows.description: music festival in the United States
rows.hook: was started by Jane's Addiction's frontman and now fills a Chicago lakefront park each summer

rows.label: BBC Proms
rows.description: eight-week summer season of daily orchestral classical music concerts
rows.hook: ends each summer season with the flag-waving Last Night at the Royal Albert Hall

rows.label: Navratri
rows.description: annual Hindu festival
rows.hook: spans nine nights of dance and worship of the goddess Durga, including the garba dance

rows.label: Tomorrowland
rows.description: Belgian annual electronic dance music festival held in Boom, Antwerp
rows.hook: is a giant electronic dance event known for fairytale stages and its Mainstage, drawing crowds each July

rows.label: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival
rows.description: annual music and arts festival held in April in Indio, California, United States
rows.hook: is a star-studded spring weekend in the desert, famous for fashion, influencers and huge headliners

rows.label: Telluride Film Festival
rows.description: annual film festival held in Telluride, USA
rows.hook: is a small, Labor Day event in a Colorado mountain town that keeps its lineup secret until it starts

rows.label: Vijayadashami
rows.description: annual Hindu festival, celebrated at the end of Navaratri
rows.hook: marks the triumph of good over evil, with giant effigies of the demon king Ravana burned at dusk

rows.label: South by Southwest
rows.description: annual festival held in Austin, USA
rows.hook: combines a massive spring gathering of movies, tech startups and live bands in the Texas capital

rows.label: Edinburgh Festival Fringe
rows.description: arts festival
rows.hook: is the world's largest arts gathering, taking over a Scottish capital each August with comedy and theatre

rows.label: Warped Tour
rows.description: annual traveling rock music festival
rows.hook: roamed North America each summer with punk and pop-punk bands playing on multiple stages in parking lots

rows.label: Rock in Rio
rows.description: Brazilian music festival
rows.hook: launched with a huge crowd and became known as one of the biggest music events on Earth
